title: blob-server: conditional Blob/set via the opt-in registration path
description:
Design: docs/design/blobext.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: B18. Crates: jmap-blob-types, jmap-blob-server. Size: S.

Per docs/design/DECISIONS.md decisions 1 and 2, docs/design/blobext.md §4 (SetObject note), §7 (ConditionalBackend bullet), §9 'conditional-02', and docs/design/conditional.md §5/§9 (draft-ietf-jmap-conditional-02): impl jmap_types::SetObject for BlobObject (SERVER_SET [id, size], CLIENT_SETTABLE [type, expires], IMMUTABLE [type]); add register_blob_handlers_with_conditional<B: BlobBackend + ConditionalBackend> registering Blob/set with ClosureHandler::new_set::<BlobObject> (register_blob_handlers unchanged); memory backend implements ConditionalBackend with the blob map on ScopedState so atomic rollback discards created blobs incl. noPersist. No evaluation code in set.rs. Apply the ruling for blobext.md §12 Q1 (type/expires pointers) once Mark answers. Needs the JMAP-y1yu pieces: ConditionalBackend/new_set, dispatcher evaluator, ScopedState. Acceptance: tests ifUnchangedBy {"B1": {"size": 13}} pass and fail (stateMismatch), {"B1": null}, atomic rollback with the memory backend; conditional args without the URI -> invalidArguments (decision 2); conditional_gaps() empty with the opt-in registration; public-api snapshot.
